product_one_liner.value: PolyAI provides enterprise dialog agents that automate customer-service conversations across voice and chat.

employee_band.notes: The company About page reports 250 employees.

hq_location.notes: The company profile identifies San Francisco as headquarters; the AWS partner directory and PitchBook instead identify London, United Kingdom.

eng_blog.notes: Paul Annetts, Principal Engineer, explains Bazel builds and distroless containers; Tomasz Cichy, Machine Learning Engineer, explains training the Owl speech-recognition model.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A live application page is available for Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic AI, involving production LLM agents and evaluations; this role is not present on the current board index.

model_provider.value: PolyAI Raven; OpenAI GPT models; Anthropic Claude and Amazon Nova models through Amazon Bedrock; PolyAI Owl speech recognition built on an NVIDIA pretrained model.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page displays all five under compliance certifications and protocols. Documentation explicitly states ISO 27001 certification and SOC 2 Type II compliance; GDPR is a compliance claim, while HIPAA and PCI DSS wording is qualified by “where relevant,” not an unconditional certification claim.

last_funding.notes: Announced December 15, 2025; latest publicly announced round located.

raised_18mo.notes: The December 15, 2025 round falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current board lists Staff Product Manager (Runtime Team), Senior Marketing Manager, EMEA, and Senior Account Manager; none meets the requested SDR/BDR/account-executive title criteria.

launched_6mo.notes: Wren, an agent that analyzes conversations and tests improvements to dialog agents, was introduced September 9, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On May 12, 2026, PolyAI announced senior hires including Helen Greul as SVP of Product Engineering and Morgan Norman as CMO, within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Job-post signals: the marketing role requests Salesforce experience; the business-development management role names HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and PostHog among example tools. These are hiring signals, not proof that every named tool is deployed internally.
